name: Weighted Dice
commentary:
If you reroll a shop and **none** of the new pieces are units already on your board or bench, you're refunded 1–2 gold, making that reroll either free or half price. (If an owned piece does show up, you get nothing.)

Very useful for roll-heavy boards, especially early when you own few units, so most rerolls whiff and trigger the refund.

source.name: Weighted Dice
source.description: Refund 1~2 random Gold if you fail to recruit any owned chess piece.
